description: This file implements the AttributeExpressionImpl class, which represents an attribute-based expression within a query framework. It provides methods for accepting visitors for different expression types (sort, filter, exists) and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: AttributeExpressionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of attribute expressions supporting filtering, sorting, and existence checks within query expressions.

methods.name: AttributeExpressionImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute expression with a key. Ensures the key is not null.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the attribute key associated with this expression.

methods.name: acceptSortVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for handling sort field expressions, delegating to the visitor with the attribute key.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for handling filter field expressions, delegating to the visitor with the attribute key.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for handling exists field expressions, delegating to the visitor with the attribute key.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a general field expression visitor, delegating to the visitor with the attribute key.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the attribute key.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, specifically whether it is an AttributeExpressionImpl with the same key.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the attribute expression.
